steps.name: http-adapter-contract-foundation
steps.summary: Added framework-neutral HttpRequest/HttpRoute/HttpRouter/HttpResponse foundation with JSON decode errors, route miss/method mismatch responses, deterministic request ids, response byte serialization, and public API exports.

steps.name: auth-order-http-routes
steps.summary: Added auth/order HTTP route manifests and registration helpers for AuthApi session lifecycle routes and OrdersApi order creation while preserving facade ApiResponse status/body mapping.

steps.name: checkout-payment-http-routes
steps.summary: Added checkout tracking and payment txHash HTTP route manifests plus registration helpers, preserving path/query lookup, X-Request-Id causation, and optional commandId passthrough.

steps.name: operator-http-routes
steps.summary: Added operator dashboard/detail HTTP route manifest and registration helper, preserving ADMIN policy errors plus order lifecycle, payment failure, and outbox retry observability payload fields.

steps.name: wsgi-runtime-preview
steps.summary: Added WSGI adapter factory, deterministic HTTP route manifest helpers, public API exports, and bounded api/serve-api runtime previews that return 13 route specs without starting a server.

steps.name: http-adapter-phase-verification
steps.summary: Added HTTP adapter public contract tests, README/app README documentation for bounded api/serve-api previews, verified all phase 7 route families and existing runtime/e2e contracts, and kept next phase candidates explicit.
